title: Per-region ecology file (#29) — the species x habitat x area x time join
description: Ecology is the join from which game encounters (#7) and show ambient population (LIVING-WORLD P2) both derive. This format carries NO numbers: weights live in spawn tables, rates nowhere until canon sets them. A resident row requires a canon source in evidence. Display names follow the display sweep (Region 1 displays as Iridescence); production names stay in production docs (two-lane law).

areaId.description: Join to spawn-table files (#7). Null if the zone has no encounter file.

showLocation.description: Show-side location (LIVING-WORLD). Null if no show counterpart is established.

habitatClasses.description: The spawn schema's enum (sky/small-ground/water/perch/night) plus two additive extensions the Forest forces: canopy (surface, inhabited) and depths. Landing note: the spawn schema enum gains the same two values — additive, flagged in STAGING.md.

evidence.description: The canon source that places this species here. No source, no row.

timeBands.description: Presence marks (speciesIds) ONLY where a canon source speaks in time terms (show P6 time truth). Null = canon silent.

status.description: Zone provenance; the Dark Forest depths zone is 'OPEN — canon does not stock the depths' with residents [].
